generated_texts: I'm frustrated because my recently issued card was repeatedly declined when I tried to use it. Can you please explain why this is happening and what steps I can take to resolve the issue and avoid future declines?
I'm having trouble with my card, as it's consistently being declined whenever I attempt to use it. Despite trying multiple times, it's still being rejected, and I'm unsure why this is happening.
If someone wants to add funds to my account, can they do so using my card?
What are the steps to connect a new payment card to my account?
Can you confirm if my top-up was unsuccessful? It appears it didn't go through.
Can I set up recurring deposits to my account, so I can maintain a steady balance while I'm away on my trip?
It seems that my request to top up was unsuccessful.
what is the charge for topping up my account using my card?
Why is the transfer to the other bank being rejected? Is my account balance not sufficient? I've tried initiating the transfer five times, but it keeps getting declined.
I'm having trouble locating the funds I recently deposited.
Can I get a new card? I'd like to purchase an additional one.
A withdrawal was processed on my account, but I didn't initiate it and I still have my card in my possession. What should I do?
I'm upset because I was unexpectedly charged a fee for making a transaction with my credit card.
Can a friend make a personal payment on my behalf?
Reasons for reversal of top-up transaction.
Is there a fee associated with obtaining a replacement card, as mine is nearing its expiration date, and I'd also appreciate knowing how long it takes to receive the new one?
I require guidance on the maximum amount I can increase my limits.
We're having trouble verifying your identity through our system.
I've stopped making payments on this card.
Are there any fees associated with a new card?

I'm confused, I've been making transfers without any issues, but just now, when I tried to make another one, it got declined. I've tried a few times, but the result is the same. Can you help me figure out what's going on?
If the ATM or payment terminal declines my card, what should I do next?
I'm trying to figure out where this payment is coming from.
I didn't reverse my top-up.
Can I transfer funds from my bank account to add more money to it?
I'm unable to add funds to my account.
I'd like to transfer funds into my account.
Can you provide an estimate for the delivery of my card within a 2-day timeframe?
It appears that an unauthorized party has used my card to make a purchase, what steps can I take?
Why haven't my friend received the transfer I sent her? Is there a way to expedite the transfer process, as she's in urgent need of the funds?
How can my boss deposit funds directly to my card?
Are you limiting my limit increases?
I'm experiencing an issue with an unauthorized cash withdrawal that was made on my account. I still have my card in my possession, but the transaction doesn't seem to be recognized by the system.
Can I receive payment through this system?
source_texts: I am very upset that i went to use my new card today and it kept getting declined. Why is this happening and what do I do to not have it declined?
I NEED HELP WITH MY CARD!!!!! please. It keeps getting declined when I try to use it. I have tried a few times to use it and it keeps getting rejected. I have no idea why.
If I want a friend to top off my account, can they?
How do I link a new payment card?
Can I tell if my top off didn't work?  It doesn't seem to have.
Can I add money in intervals to my account?  I will be traveling.
It does not appear that my message went through.
how much does it cost to add money
Why wont the other bank take my money?? Is it not good enough?? There's sufficient funds but I keep getting denied a standard transfer. Ive tried 5 times!
Help, I don't see my money i just added.
How much is it to buy another card? I was hoping to buy another one.
A WD was just made on my account, but it was not me and I still have my card.  What to do?
I am angry that I got charged for using my card.
Is it possible for a friend to personally send me a payment?
Reasons for top up cancellation.
Does it cost anything to get a new card? Mine's about to expire and I'd also like to know how long it takes to get the new one.
I need someone to assist me with explaining how much I can top-up.
I am not recognized by the app.
I have cancelled payments to this card.
Any charges applicable for new card?

Why do you keep declining my transfers? it's always been working really well so far but when I tried to buy something just now the card got declined, I tried couple of times already  but same thing is happening.
What do I do if the machine rejects my card?
I need to know where this charge is coming from?
I didn't cancel my top-up.
Can I use my bank account to send me more money?
I cant transfer money into my account
I need to deposit money to my account
how much to get my card in 2 days?
It looks like someone besides me ordered something with my card, what should I do?
How long do transfers typically take? Is there a way of speeding the process up? My friend needs the money I sent her desperately.
How can my boss pay me directly to the card?
Do you limit my top-offs?
There are incorrect charges on my account, there was a WD that was made by someone else.  I still have my card though.
Can i get payed through this system?
